name: lava-web
description: LAVA - research console over the NASA microgravity combustion corpus

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lava-project --branch=main
scripts.css:scope: python3 scripts/scope_css.py src/styles/home.css .surface-landing src/styles/home.scoped.css lv-land && python3 scripts/scope_css.py src/styles/login.css .surface-login src/styles/login.scoped.css lv-login && python3 scripts/scope_css.py src/styles/app.css .console src/styles/app.scoped.css lv-app && python3 scripts/scope_css.py src/styles/styles.css .console-chat src/styles/styles.scoped.css lv-chat
